projects.sectionSubtitle: Selected systems emphasizing architectural rigor, scientific telemetry streaming, and transactional concurrency control.

aetherscope.title: AetherScope
aetherscope.description: Interactive deep-space exploration platform and spectroscopic laboratory powered by authentic scientific survey data from space missions (JWST, Hubble, Chandra, Gaia, AllWISE, DSS2). Features 360° visualization in WebGL2 / Aladin Lite (Rust/WASM), real-time multi-wavelength channel blending (infrared, optical, X-ray), physical-chemical analysis, and JSON catalog export with Supabase.

rescuesync.title: RescueSync / DSSD
rescuesync.description: Distributed platform designed for emergency response coordination and concurrent real-time resource allocation across NGOs and rescue brigades. Orchestrated via BPM workflow engines, role-based access control (JWT), and containerized microservice architecture.

alquilando.title: Alquilando
alquilando.description: Backend engine for vehicle fleet management and reservation scheduling, featuring strict temporal concurrency control, user permissions, and relational referential integrity.
